issue.title: [BUG] workspace grep duplicates context lines across adjacent matches

steps: Create a file named f.ts whose content is exactly these five lines: MATCH_A, x, MATCH_B, y, z (one per line).
Run the workspace grep tool with { "pattern": "MATCH", "path": "f.ts", "contextLines": 2 } and show the output.
expected: Overlapping context windows are merged into one hunk, so each of the five lines of f.ts appears exactly once in the grep output.
defect: Each match's context window is emitted independently, so lines such as `x` and `MATCH_B` appear twice (once as context of MATCH_A and again around MATCH_B).
Root cause: FIXED UPSTREAM IN https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/17274 (commit 65a72e70c25eedea8ff985a6624b96be2850236b). Before the fix, the host-side search loop in packages/core/src/workspace/tools/grep.ts (grepTool.execute) handled every matching line on its own: it pushed the `contextLines` lines before the match, the match, the lines after it, and then a `--` separator, without remembering which lines had already been emitted. When two matches are within 2*contextLines of each other their windows overlap, so the same source line is printed several times and a matching line can reappear as another match's context; a trailing `--` is also printed after the last hunk. The fix collects match/context line ranges per file and merges overlapping or adjacent windows into single hunks, separating distinct hunks with `--` and omitting the trailing separator. The fix (2026-05-30) is first released in mastracode@0.21.2 (@mastra/core@1.38.0). The pinned revision (mastracode@0.41.0) already contains it, and no mastracode release before the fix provides the ACP entry (ACP first ships in mastracode@0.25.0), so the case is pinned and is not expected to reproduce.
